en.t: The lyrics of the saibara song "Plum Branch" are:

units.source_text: 黄莺惯宿梅花枝，直到春来不住啼，直到春来不住啼。

en.t: The yellow warbler, used to roosting on plum-blossom branches, keeps singing until spring comes, keeps singing until spring comes.

units.source_text: 阳春白雪尚飞飞，阳春白雪尚飞飞。”

en.t: In bright spring, white snow still drifts and flutters; in bright spring, white snow still drifts and flutters."
The title of this chapter is based on these lines.
